correctness.rationale: For the literal stated pair of opposite-direction two-site exchange Lindblad jump operators with identical rates, the adjoint dissipator acts on O_i as O_j-O_i and on O_j as O_i-O_j, an operator identity valid for entangled inputs. Summing both ordered pairs yields c_ij=(1-lambda_i)w_ij+(1-lambda_j)w_ji and the exact symmetric-Laplacian first-moment ODE xdot=-(Lambda+L_c)x+Lambda s, since the Ising Hamiltonian commutes with O_i. The Chu-directed FJ off-diagonal coefficient omits (1-lambda_j)w_ji; equality on all initial vectors forces every one of those nonnegative incoming coefficients zero, hence all exchange rates zero. Weighted graph Laplacian quadratic form establishes convergence/anchor uniqueness. Independently checked the rational directed 3-node unanchored witness: actual arithmetic consensus -1/3 versus FJ left-eigenvector consensus -3/5, and the positive symmetric Laplacian. Conditional premise that Chu Eq14 is transcribed exactly is not independently verified from the original full text due access restrictions.
